objective: Certificar en READ_ONLY la implementacion backend integrada de Gate12K sin reabrir Gate12J. Validar rutas registradas, contrato de servicio Persona-Link, compilacion, pruebas unitarias especificas y estado SQL fisico sin mutar datos. Confirmar que SocioID sigue siendo identidad operacional, PersonaID sigue sin backfill automatico, ClienteCRMID no fue reemplazado, Gobierno_Persona/Gobierno_PersonaVinculo permanecen sin mutacion por el postcheck y Produccion no fue tocada.

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS db_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login;

queries.name: cava_socios_persona_state
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_sin_persona,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_con_persona FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: cava_fk
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND fk.name=N'FK_CavaSocios_Socios_GobiernoPersona';

queries.name: persona_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_personas FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona;

queries.name: persona_vinculo_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_vinculos FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo;

queries.name: cliente_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_clientes FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo;

queries.name: legacy_clientecrm_presence
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN ClienteCRMID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clientecrm_null,SUM(CASE WHEN ClienteCRMID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clientecrm_present FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: child_fk_integrity
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS trusted_child_fks FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'CavaSocios_Botellas',N'CavaSocios_Cargos',N'CavaSocios_Movimientos') AND pc.name=N'SocioID' AND rc.name=N'SocioID' AND fk.is_disabled=0 AND fk.is_not_trusted=0;

constraints: Botellas Cargos Movimientos remain linked by SocioID
